undercrown--undercrown-maduro.description: Drew Estate's tribute to the rollers and bunchers of its Estelí factory floor, the Undercrown Maduro wraps Brazilian Mata Fina and Nicaraguan filler in a stalk-cut Connecticut Habano binder and a dark Mexican San Andrés leaf. It smokes medium to full, earthy and rich, with a natural sweetness running through a dense, textured smoke.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Undercrown Maduro Belicoso review
Casas Fumando – Undercrown Maduro Coronet review

thirds.notes: Earthy with a soft sweetness at first, then leathery with a charred, meaty edge and red pepper through the nose.
A charcoal-like smoke and leather take hold, the pepper builds, and a coffee note appears around the midpoint.
Coffee leads the final third, over leather and steady pepper, with sweetness still underneath.

undercrown--undercrown-shade.description: The creamier follow-up to the original Undercrown, developed by the same Drew Estate rollers: an Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper over a Sumatra binder and Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. It stays medium-bodied and smooth, with earth, vanilla and caramel sweetness touched by a light pepper, a fit for a morning or a long afternoon.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Undercrown Shade Gran Toro review
Blind Man's Puff – Undercrown Shade Gran Toro review
Stogie Press – Undercrown Shade Robusto review

thirds.notes: A caramel-like sweetness with a little vanilla and cream, light pepper, and hay and earth on the retrohale.
Creamy leather and nuts come forward with an allspice sweetness, while earth and hay grow in the background.
Coffee develops alongside cedar and earth, a little pepper returns, and a slightly bitter edge can show.

undercrown--undercrown-10-uc-10.description: Blended for ten years of Undercrown, the UC 10 dresses Nicaraguan and Honduran filler and a Connecticut Broadleaf binder in a Mexican San Andrés Negro Último Corte wrapper, taken from the top of the plant. Full-bodied and dark, it pairs black pepper with cacao, earth and the sweetness of dried cherries and raisins.

thirds.notes: Espresso and black pepper open, with dark chocolate, dried cherry and leather on the retrohale.
Leather and oak join the espresso and chocolate, and the pepper softens into a creamy, spiced sweetness.
Espresso and dark chocolate return to the front, with earth, cedar and white pepper on a toasty close.

undercrown--undercrown-el-tigre-dominica.description: A Dominican accent for the Undercrown family, made at La Gran Fábrica Drew Estate in Nicaragua: Dominican-led HVA and C-98 filler, a Connecticut Corojo H99 hybrid binder and an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, finished with a soft box-press. Medium to full, it brings silky spice, white pepper and roasted espresso over an earthy base.

sources.title: Drew Estate – Undercrown El Tigre Dominicano
